title: revert(plugin-list): roll back objectui#11999 so the console's eager closure is under its ceiling again (objectui#12007)
body:
Fixes #12007
Clause-②: no — it restores `packages/plugin-list` byte for byte to its state at `aaba8655a`; no export, prop, type member or accepted input changes.

## What

Reverts `aa67386a5` (PR objectui#11999, the toolbar field-list read of objectui#11984) **alone**, as one `git revert` commit, plus one changeset.

- objectui#12002 (`aaba8655a`, the repeater half of objectui#11880) **stays**: it fits under the ceiling alone.
- **No ceiling raise.** `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` is untouched; `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` still reads 3,391,484.
- objectui#11984's accepted change re-lands unchanged after objectui#11939's reclaim frees the bytes (ruling A on objectui#11798; the rollback follows ruling `6056819248` step 1 on objectui#11942).

## Files

- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`: restored. Its blob equals `git rev-parse aaba8655a:packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (`6acc4893d2e2`).
- `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.fieldListRead-11984.test.tsx`: removed (absent at HEAD, as at `aaba8655a`).
- `.changeset/11984-toolbar-field-lists-read.md`: removed, together with the change it declared.
- `.changeset/12007-revert-toolbar-field-list-read.md`: added, `@object-ui/plugin-list` patch, one sentence declaring the rollback.

`git diff --name-status aaba8655a HEAD` names exactly one path: the new changeset.

## Verification, at HEAD `3605d3aa2`

- **Eager closure, local** (`apps/console`, `CI=true pnpm exec vite build`): `dist/eager-closure.json` `eagerGzipBytes` is **3,391,417**, under the 3,391,484 ceiling by 67 B. `pnpm check:eager-closure` prints "✅ Console eager closure is 3311.9 KB gzipped across 336 of 2458 chunks (budget: 3312.0 KB, headroom: 0.1 KB)." Outside `.changeset/` the tree is identical to `aaba8655a`'s, so this is that tree's reading.
- **vitest** (repo root, `pnpm exec vitest run`) over the 100 `plugin-list` test files naming `ListView`, `canReadField`, `hiddenFields`, `rowColor` or `GroupingEditor`, plus `column-identity.ratchet.test.ts` and `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`: `Test Files 102 passed (102)`, `Tests 1117 passed (1117)`.
- **`pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list type-check`**, with its dependency closure built first: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: "✅ 2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: "✅ No changeset declares a `major` bump."
- `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`: exit 0 (report-only). It reports the deleted `.changeset/11984-toolbar-field-lists-read.md` with "GONE from the declaration: @object-ui/plugin-list". That deletion is the intent: the declared change leaves with it, and the new changeset declares the rollback.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`: pass.
- NOT MEASURED locally: `pnpm lint` and the full test farm. Both are CI's.

The pin on objectui#12007 is this PR's own `Bundle Analysis` reading at or under 3312.0 KB, then a green push `Bundle Analysis` on `main`.

- With `OS_CHANGESET_OVERWRITE_ENFORCE=1`, `check-changeset-overwrite` exits 1 on this diff but still prints its "Report-only: this gate does not fail the build" paragraph. CI does not set the switch, so the path is dormant. Noted, not filed; no carrier.
